explanations.title: Activity 4: transcribe five sentences
explanations.body: The sentences played in the book:

examples.text: Makakaranas ang Kamaynilaan ng dagliang pag-ulan, pagkidlat, at pagkulog.
examples.translation: Greater Manila will experience sudden rain, lightning and thunder.

examples.text: Ibinaba na ng PAGASA sa Signal Number Isa ang babala ng bagyo sa Kalakhang Maynila.
examples.translation: PAGASA has lowered the storm warning in Metro Manila to Signal Number One.

examples.text: Maaraw at maaliwalas ang panahon ngayon sa hilagang Luzon.
examples.translation: The weather today in northern Luzon is sunny and clear.

examples.text: Pulu-pulong pag-ulan na tatagal nang isa hanggang dalawang oras ang iiral sa Cebu.
examples.translation: Isolated rain showers lasting one to two hours will prevail in Cebu.

examples.text: Maulan, maulap na may kasamang pagkulog at pagkidlat sa Silangang Bisaya.
examples.translation: Rainy, cloudy with thunder and lightning in Eastern Visayas.

explanations.title: Activity 5: translate into Tagalog (the book’s key)

examples.text: Magiging maulap ang buong bansa na may pulu-pulong pag-ulan o pagkidlat-pagkulog.
examples.translation: The whole country will be partly cloudy with isolated rain showers or thunderstorms.

examples.text: Katamtaman hanggang sa malakas na hangin mula sa silangan hanggang timog-silangan ang iiral sa Hilagang Luzon.
examples.translation: Moderate to strong winds blowing from the east to southeast will prevail over Northern Luzon.

examples.text: Ang mga baybaying-dagat sa mga lugar na ito ay magiging katamtaman hanggang sa maalon.
examples.translation: The coastal waters along these areas will be moderate to rough.

examples.text: Sa ibang dako, mahina ang hangin hanggang sa katamtaman mula sa hilagang-silangan na may banayad hanggang sa katamtaman ang pag-alon ng karagatan.
examples.translation: Elsewhere, winds will be light to moderate coming from the northeast with slight to moderate seas.

examples.text: Narito ang pagtaya ng panahon para sa Kabikulan, Silangang Kabisayaan, at ng mga lugar sa CARAGA at Davao.
examples.translation: Here is the weather report for the Bicol Region, Eastern Visayas, and the regions of CARAGA and Davao.

explanations.title: Activity 6: a news report (the book’s script)
explanations.body: The book asks for five essential elements of information (EEIs). Key: twenty-three domestic flights were canceled Tuesday; nineteen provinces in Mindanao were affected by the typhoon; signal number one was raised in the affected regions; the airlines affected were Cebu Pacific, Air Philippines, Philippine Airlines and Zest Airways; flights were canceled because of tropical cyclone Crising. Another answer: President Aquino’s trip to Negros Oriental was also canceled. (The report is adapted from a Philstar story.)

examples.text: Kanselado ang dalawampu’t tatlong domestic flights kabilang ang kay Pangulong Benigno Aquino III patungong Negros Oriental ngayong Martes dahil sa tropical cyclone na Crising.
examples.translation: Twenty-three domestic flights, including that of President Benigno Aquino III to Negros Oriental, are canceled this Tuesday because of tropical cyclone “Crising.”

examples.text: Ang mga biyahe ng Cebu Pacific, Air Philippines, Philippine Airlines, at Zest Airways ang naapektuhan dahil sa sama ng panahon kung saan labinsiyam na probinsiya sa Mindanao ang isinailalim sa public storm signal number one.
examples.translation: The flights of Cebu Pacific, Air Philippines, Philippine Airlines and Zest Airways were affected by the bad weather, because of which nineteen provinces in Mindanao were placed under public storm signal number one.

lessons.title: 149. C9 L1 · Listening: kinds of weather, two seasons, a forecast
lessons.subtitle: Mataas ang sikat ng araw · Malakas ang ulan at bumabaha · Maulap na kalangitan na may mahihinang pag-ulan

explanations.title: Activity 7: kinds of weather (the book’s script)
explanations.body: Key (weather and description): sunny: the sun is high and hot; cloudy: the sky is full of clouds that partially cover the sun; windy: strong winds or breeze; rainy: overcast skies and rain.

examples.text: Maaraw na Panahon.
examples.translation: Sunny weather.

examples.text: Kapag maaraw ang panahon, mataas ang sikat ng araw at may kainitan.
examples.translation: When the weather is sunny, the sun is high and there is some heat.

examples.text: Maulap na Panahon.
examples.translation: Cloudy weather.

examples.text: Kung maulap naman ang panahon, mapapansin na puno ng ulap ang kalangitan.
examples.translation: If the weather is cloudy, you will notice the sky is full of clouds.

examples.text: At, bahagyang natatakpan nito ang araw.
examples.translation: And they partly cover the sun.

examples.text: Mahanging Panahon.
examples.translation: Windy weather.

examples.text: Kapag naman mahangin ang panahon, mapapansin na may kalakasan ang ihip ng hangin.
examples.translation: When the weather is windy, you will notice the wind blows moderately strong.

examples.text: Maulang panahon.
examples.translation: Rainy weather.

examples.text: Makulimlim ang langit at may pumapatak na mga tubig mula doon.
examples.translation: The sky is overcast and water is falling from it.

explanations.title: Activity 8, speaker 1: the rainy season (the book’s script)
explanations.body: Key (Tagalog terms and an activity): malakas ang ulan, bumabaha, umaambon, umuulan, malamig na panahon, baha; activities: bathing outside in the rain; eating fried rice, dried fish, chocolate porridge and arroz caldo; sleeping.

examples.text: Naaalala ko noong bata ako, masayang-masaya ako sa tuwing malakas ang ulan at bumabaha sapagkat walang pasok.
examples.translation: I remember that when I was a child, I was very happy whenever the rain was heavy and there were floods because there was no school.

examples.text: Nasa labas na kami ng mga kaibigan ko dahil gustung-gusto naming naliligo sa ulan.
examples.translation: My friends and I would already be outside because we really loved bathing in the rain.

examples.text: Konting ulan lang bumabaha na nang isang talampakan sa amin.
examples.translation: With just a little rain it would flood a foot deep where we lived.

examples.text: Sa bahay naman, ang sarap kumain ng sinangag, tuyo, tsampurado, o arroz caldo.
examples.translation: At home, it was delicious to eat fried rice, dried fish, chocolate porridge or arroz caldo.

examples.text: At kung wala na talagang magawa sa malamig na panahon, ang sarap matulog.
examples.translation: And if there was really nothing to do in the cold weather, it was nice to sleep.

explanations.title: Activity 8, speaker 2: the dry season (the book’s script)
explanations.body: Key: tag-init, napakainit ng panahon, maalinsangan, manaka-nakang pag-ulan, pagkulog, pagkidlat; activities: biked and rode a boat at Burnham Park; went down from Baguio to Pangasinan’s Hundred Islands; swam and snorkeled in Pangasinan.

examples.text: Sumama akong umuwi sa ’Pinas kasama nina Tita Julie at mga pinsan ko.
examples.translation: I went home to the Philippines with Auntie Julie and my cousins.

examples.text: Dahil tag-init, sa Baguio kami tumira.
examples.translation: Because it was summer, we stayed in Baguio.

examples.text: Nagbisikleta at namangka kami sa Burnham Park.
examples.translation: We biked and rode a boat at Burnham Park.

examples.text: Bumaba rin kami ng Baguio at nagpunta sa Hundred Islands sa Pangasinan.
examples.translation: We also went down from Baguio and went to the Hundred Islands in Pangasinan.

examples.text: Doon nag-swimming at nag-snorkeling kaming magpipinsan.
examples.translation: There we cousins swam and snorkeled.

examples.text: Kahit na napakainit ng panahon at maalinsangan nagkaroon pa rin ng manaka-nakang pag-ulan, pagkulog at pagkidlat, nung nasa Pangasinan kami.
examples.translation: Even though the weather was very hot and muggy, there were still occasional rains, thunder and lightning when we were in Pangasinan.

explanations.title: Activity 9, segment 1: a weather forecast (the book’s script)
explanations.body: Key: 1. c (the northeast monsoon); 2. a (cloudy skies with light rains); 3. c (partly cloudy skies).

examples.text: Maganda nga ang panahon sa buong bansa.
examples.translation: The weather is indeed nice throughout the country.

examples.text: Kaugnay nito ang patuloy na pag-iral ng hanging amihan sa Luzon at Eastern Visayas.
examples.translation: Related to this is the continued prevailing of the northeast monsoon in Luzon and Eastern Visayas.

examples.text: Kaya sa lagay ng panahon ngayong araw, ang Cagayan Valley at mga probinsiya ng Aurora at Quezon ay makakaranas ng maulap na kalangitan na may mahihinang pag-ulan.
examples.translation: So in today’s weather, Cagayan Valley and the provinces of Aurora and Quezon will experience cloudy skies with light rains.

examples.text: Ang natitirang bahagi ng Luzon at Eastern Visayas ay makakaranas naman ng bahagyang maulap na kalangitan kaya maganda at mainit ang panahon diyan ngayon sa labas.
examples.translation: The rest of Luzon and Eastern Visayas will experience partly cloudy skies, so the weather out there now is nice and hot.

examples.text: Ganito rin ang lagay ng panahon sa natitirang bahagi ng Visayas at buong Mindanao.
examples.translation: The weather is the same in the rest of Visayas and all of Mindanao.

examples.text: Bagama’t patuloy ang pag-iral ng amihan hindi na ito kalamigan at maaasahan na malapit na ang ating transition to summer.
examples.translation: Although the amihan continues to prevail, it is not as cold anymore and we can expect that our transition to summer is near.

examples.text: Kaya’t kahit hindi na ganun kalamigan ang dala ng amihan inaasahan pa rin ang maalon hanggang napakaalon na kondisyon ng karagatan kaya ibayong pag-iingat po ang ating paalala sa mga maglalayag ngayong Lunes.
examples.translation: So even though the amihan is no longer that cold, rough to very rough sea conditions are still expected, so our reminder is extra caution to those who will sail this Monday.

explanations.title: Activity 10: guided conversation
explanations.body: You are Adriana, a foreign language student and a Tagalog heritage speaker, selected for advanced Tagalog courses at De La Salle University in Lipa, Batangas. A: share the good news with Cathy; say the class starts in June; ask what the weather is like in June. B: congratulate her; say June is a rainy season and typhoons normally occur from June to November. A: ask if there are nice beaches in Batangas. B: say yes, plenty. A: say you feel lucky because you enjoy swimming; you want to know more but are running late for your next class. B: say no problem, you can call her anytime. A sample:

examples.text: Cathy, may magandang balita ako. Napili akong mag-advanced na kurso sa Tagalog sa Lipa, Batangas. Magsisimula ang klase sa Hunyo. Ano ang panahon sa Hunyo?
examples.translation: Adriana: Cathy, I have good news. I was selected to take an advanced course in Tagalog in Lipa, Batangas. The class starts in June. What is the weather like in June?

examples.text: Binabati kita! Maulan ang Hunyo. Karaniwang may bagyo mula Hunyo hanggang Nobyembre.
examples.translation: Cathy: Congratulations! June is rainy. Typhoons normally occur from June to November.

examples.text: May magaganda bang beach sa Batangas?
examples.translation: Adriana: Are there nice beaches in Batangas?

examples.text: Oo, maraming magagandang beach doon.
examples.translation: Cathy: Yes, there are many nice beaches there.

examples.text: Swerte ako dahil mahilig akong lumangoy. Gusto ko pang malaman ang tungkol sa lugar pero huli na ako sa susunod kong klase.
examples.translation: Adriana: I am lucky because I love to swim. I want to know more about the place but I am late for my next class.

examples.text: Walang problema. Puwede mo akong tawagan anumang oras.
examples.translation: Cathy: No problem. You can call me anytime.

explanations.title: Activity 11: role play, LCPL McDonald and LCPL Smith
explanations.body: Smith was previously assigned to Zamboanga City; McDonald will be deployed there soon. A (McDonald): greet Smith; say around May and ask what the weather is like; say you need to buy more shorts and cotton shirts and didn’t realize the temperature can be that high; thank your friend and promise to call back. B (Smith): return the greeting and ask his departure schedule; tell him the weather is generally humid and the temperature can go over 35°C, bring a lot of shorts, undershirts and cotton shirts; say good luck and to call anytime. A sample:

examples.text: Kumusta, Smith! Aalis ako mga Mayo. Ano ang panahon sa Zamboanga?
examples.translation: McDonald: Hello, Smith! I will leave around May. What is the weather like in Zamboanga?

examples.text: Kumusta! Kailan ang alis mo? Mahalumigmig ang panahon doon at puwedeng lumampas ng trenta y singko antas ng sentigrado ang temperatura. Magdala ka ng maraming shorts, undershirts at cotton shirts.
examples.translation: Smith: Hello! When do you leave? The weather there is humid and the temperature can go over thirty-five degrees centigrade. Bring many shorts, undershirts and cotton shirts.

examples.text: Kailangan ko pang bumili ng shorts at cotton shirts. Hindi ko alam na puwedeng ganoon kataas ang temperatura. Salamat! Tatawagan kita ulit.
examples.translation: McDonald: I still need to buy shorts and cotton shirts. I didn’t know the temperature could be that high. Thank you! I will call you again.

examples.text: Good luck! Tawag ka anumang oras.
examples.translation: Smith: Good luck! Call anytime.

explanations.title: Activity 12: challenge yourself
explanations.body: You are a student of Tagalog at DLI from Connecticut, in Monterey for the first time. Share your experience of the four seasons in your hometown (months and length of each season; coolest, hottest and average temperatures; the shades and colors of the trees; one favorite activity for each season) and compare and contrast them with the weather in Monterey. Use the key words taglamig, tag-init, taglagas, tagsibol, antas sentigrado, antas ng temperatura, niyebe, malamig, mainit, maaliwalas, panahon, halumigmig, hangin, maulap and other weather words, intensifiers, months, days and time words, at least 10 to 15 weather-related words, in the past tense (individual work, left out).

rows: Metro Manila, the Greater Manila Area

explanations.title: Words and phrases for weather reports and forecasts
explanations.body: The book’s sample sentences:

examples.text: Posibleng umabot sa beynte singko hanggang trenta y kuwatro degrees Celsius ang agwat ng temperatura sa Metro Manila.
examples.translation: The range of temperature in Metro Manila could reach twenty-five to thirty-four degrees Celsius.

examples.text: Dulot ng hanging amihan at hindi ng isang bagyo ang masamang panahon na nararanasan sa Metro Manila at malaking bahagi ng Luzon.
examples.translation: The bad weather being experienced in Metro Manila and a large part of Luzon is caused by the northeast monsoon and not by a typhoon.

examples.text: Nagbanta ang PAGASA na baka umabot sa kuwarenta antas ng sentigrado ang temperatura sa darating na linggo.
examples.translation: PAGASA warned that the temperature might reach forty degrees centigrade in the coming week.

examples.text: Ramdam pa rin sa Cordillera ang hagupit ng habagat.
examples.translation: The lashing of the southwest monsoon is still felt in the Cordillera.

examples.text: Malamig ang simoy ng hangin at temperatura sa Tagaytay.
examples.translation: The breeze and the temperature in Tagaytay are cold.

examples.text: Patuloy na makararanas ng kalat-kalat na pag-ulan ang bansa ngayong araw.
examples.translation: The country will continue to experience scattered rain showers today.

examples.text: Isang matinding bagyo ang papalapit sa hilagang bahagi ng bansa sa loob ng labindalawang oras.
examples.translation: A severe typhoon is approaching the northern part of the country within twelve hours.

examples.text: Nagniyebe kahapon dito sa Chicago. Ang una para sa taong ito.
examples.translation: It snowed yesterday here in Chicago. The first for this year.

examples.text: Nalusaw ang isang low pressure area sa kanluran ng bansa kaya mababawasan ang mga pag-ulan sa Visayas at Mindanao.
examples.translation: A low pressure area dissipated west of the country so the rains in the Visayas and Mindanao will lessen.

examples.text: Dalawang namumuong sama ng panahon ang namataan sa lugar ng Palawan at Mindanao.
examples.translation: Two developing low-pressure areas were sighted in the Palawan and Mindanao area.

examples.text: Ilang bahagi ng Cagayan de Oro City ang nakakaranas ng pagbaha dahil sa patuloy na pag-ulan.
examples.translation: Some parts of Cagayan de Oro City are experiencing flooding because of continuous rain.

examples.text: Tumutok lamang dito sa PTV Apat para sa pinakabagong taya ng panahon.
examples.translation: Just tune in here to PTV 4 for the latest weather forecast.

explanations.title: Ma adjectives related to weather conditions

examples.text: Magiging maaliwalas ang panahon sa Metro Manila at mga kalapit na lalawigan sa Luzon.
examples.translation: The weather will be clear in Metro Manila and nearby provinces in Luzon.

examples.text: Asahan ang maaraw na panahon ngayong Lunes sa buong Kabikulan.
examples.translation: Expect sunny weather this Monday throughout Bicol.

examples.text: Inaasahang magiging mas maulan ang rainy season ngayong taon kumpara sa nakaraang dalawang taon.
examples.translation: The rainy season this year is expected to be rainier compared to the past two years.

examples.text: Maulap na kalangitan ang mararanasan sa Kabisayaan na may mahina hanggang sa katamtamang mga pag-ulan.
examples.translation: Cloudy skies will be experienced in the Visayas with light to moderate rains.

examples.text: Medyo mahangin na at makulimlim ang kalangitan, pero kalmado pa ang Pampanga River, sa Apalit, Pampanga.
examples.translation: It is getting a bit windy and the sky is overcast, but the Pampanga River in Apalit, Pampanga is still calm.

examples.text: Delikado po ang pagmamaneho ngayon dahil madulas ang mga kalsada dahil sa patuloy na pag-ulan.
examples.translation: Driving is dangerous now because the roads are slippery from the continuous rain.

examples.text: Maaliwalas ang papawirin at mahangin buong maghapon diyan po sa kanlurang bahagi ni Quezon.
examples.translation: The sky is clear and windy all day there in the western part of Quezon.

examples.text: Ang mainit at mahalumigmig na panahon ay mararanasan hanggang sa ikatlong linggo ng Mayo.
examples.translation: The hot and humid weather will be experienced until the third week of May.

examples.text: Paiba-iba ngayon ang panahon. Minsan mainit, minsan uulan.
examples.translation: The weather is changing now. Sometimes hot, sometimes it will rain.

examples.text: Asahan na makararanas ng lalong maalinsangan na temperatura sa Luzon ngayong Martes.
examples.translation: Expect an even more muggy temperature in Luzon this Tuesday.

examples.text: Mas ramdam na ang malamig na panahon dahil sa hanging amihan.
examples.translation: The cold weather is now felt more because of the amihan.

examples.text: Ngayong panahon ng tag-init, mag-ingat sa mga sakit sa balat.
examples.translation: In this summer season, beware of skin diseases.

examples.text: Nagsisimula ang kalendaryo ng eskuwelahan dito sa Estados Unidos sa taglagas.
examples.translation: The school calendar here in the United States starts in the fall.

examples.text: Karaniwan ang pagkakaroon ng yelo o pag-ulan ng niyebe tuwing taglamig.
examples.translation: Ice or snowfall is common every winter.

examples.text: Tuwang-tuwa si Bernadette makakita ng mabulaklak na parang tuwing tagsibol.
examples.translation: Bernadette is very happy to see a meadow full of flowers every spring.

explanations.title: Objectives
explanations.body: By the end of the lesson you can recognize more vocabulary commonly used in relation to weather conditions, answer comprehension questions about weather-related passages in reading and listening, transcribe and translate sentences about weather conditions in different places, describe the weather conditions of specified places and talk about the weather in different places. The structures are the core vocabulary and um verbs related to weather conditions.

explanations.title: Notes and expressions
explanations.body: Ang lakas and ang init-init are intensified adjectives. Lumolobo literally means “ballooning.” Pati ulo ko umiinit na rin (literally, even my head is getting hot too) is an idiom meaning “he is becoming temperamental because of the hot weather.” Madulas (slippery) is a ma adjective. Umaabuso, lumolobo and dumadami are examples of um “becoming” verbs. Pinas is short for Pilipinas. Filipinos in the United States often say sa PI, meaning “in the Philippines” (PI is Philippine Islands): Pumunta ako ng PI means “I went to the Philippines.”

explanations.title: Comprehension check: a summary of the comments (the book’s key)

rows: It rained heavily last night, with thunder and lightning too. He is like a child, too scared of thunder and lightning. His car almost flew with its speed and the road was slippery, yet he was more afraid of the thunder and lightning than of the slippery road.

He says the first poster is better off because at least it rained at his place. In his own place it is very hot and his temper is rising with the hot weather. There has been no rain for three months now.
The problem at his place is that it floods easily, even when it only drizzles, and that is difficult sometimes because the water gets into the house.
People are just abusive. While the population of the Philippines is increasing, so is the garbage. That is why it floods quickly everywhere.

lessons.subtitle: Pagtaya ng panahon · Katamtaman hanggang sa malakas · Pag-alon ng karagatan

explanations.title: Presentation 2: a public weather forecast
explanations.body: The 24-hour forecast announcement (Dalawampu’t apat na oras na pagtaya ng panahon). The book’s own translation is below each paragraph in the next lesson cards; here is the text with my translation:

examples.text: Ang buong bansa ay magiging bahagyang maulap na may pulu-pulong pag-ulan o pagkidlat-pagkulog lalo na sa Kabikulan, Silangang Kabisayaan at ang mga rehiyon ng CARAGA at Davao.
examples.translation: The whole country will be partly cloudy with isolated rain showers or thunderstorms, particularly over the Bicol Region, Eastern Visayas and the regions of CARAGA and Davao.

examples.text: Katamtaman hanggang sa malakas na hangin mula sa silangan hanggang timog-silangan ang iiral sa Hilagang Luzon at mula sa silangan hanggang hilagang-silangan sa silangang bahagi ng Gitna at Katimugang Luzon, Silangang Kabisayaan at ng Mindanao.
examples.translation: Moderate to strong winds from the east to southeast will prevail over Northern Luzon, and from the east to northeast over the eastern part of Central and Southern Luzon, Eastern Visayas and Mindanao.

examples.text: Ang mga baybaying-dagat sa mga lugar na ito ay magiging katamtaman hanggang sa maalon.
examples.translation: The coastal waters along these areas will be moderate to rough.

examples.text: Sa ibang dako, ang hangin ay mahina hanggang sa katamtaman mula sa hilagang-silangan na may banayad hanggang sa katamtaman ang pag-alon ng karagatan.
examples.translation: Elsewhere, winds will be light to moderate from the northeast with slight to moderate seas.

explanations.title: Notes and expressions
explanations.body: CARAGA, designated as Region 13, consists of four provinces in Northeastern Mindanao: Agusan del Norte, Agusan del Sur, Surigao del Norte and Surigao del Sur. Note how timog-silangan (southeast) and hilagang-silangan (northeast) are written. Pag-alon ng karagatan literally means “the movement of the waves in the open seas or ocean,” but in banayad hanggang sa katamtaman ang pag-alon ng karagatan it is translated “slight to moderate seas.” Note the use of Kabikulan (Bicol Region), Kabisayaan (Visayas Region), Katimugang Luzon (Southern Luzon Region) and Silangang Kabisayaan (Eastern Visayas Region). Maalon is a ma adjective; its root word is alon, “wave.”

rows: movement of waves in the open seas or ocean

explanations.title: Comprehension check (the book’s key)
explanations.body: 1. Bicol Region, Eastern Visayas, CARAGA regions and Davao have partly cloudy skies with isolated rain showers and thunderstorms. 2. Northern Luzon: b (moderate to strong winds). 3. Moderate to strong winds from the east to southeast: c (Northern Luzon). 4. Moderate to strong winds from the east to northeast: Central Luzon, Southern Luzon, Eastern Visayas and Mindanao (the eastern parts). 5. Elsewhere: the winds are light to moderate from the northeast with slight to moderate seas.

4. Can the um verb have a direct object?
Not when it is used referring to weather conditions. Weather: Umulan kahapon. Non-weather: Kumain siya ng tinapay (the direct object is tinapay).
5. What is the unique feature of the verb in conjugation?
The infinitive and past tense forms are the same.
6. What uses of the verb have you seen?
Giving directions and instructions, expressing habitual actions, expressing the idea of “becoming” and weather conditions.

explanations.title: Um verbs used with weather conditions
explanations.body: Um verbs are also used with acts of nature related to weather conditions. They are translated “becoming hot” (umiinit), “slowed down” (humina), “rained” (umulan), “there was thunder” (kumulog), “there was lightning” (kumidlat), “is drizzling” (umambon) and “gets flooded” (bumabaha). The conjugation (the book’s completed table):

explanations.title: From ma adjectives to um verbs
explanations.body: Many um verbs referring to the weather (and natural disasters that go with it) come from ma adjectives in any form (positive, comparative, superlative, intensified, moderative and so on). The book’s table of adjectives and verbs:

explanations.title: Sentences with the um verbs
explanations.body: With these verbs, the sentences have um verbs as opposed to ma adjectives. You may need to rephrase parts of the sentence, though this does not happen very often.

examples.text: Umaraw ang panahon sa Hilagang Luzon.
examples.translation: The sun was out in Northern Luzon, or, it was sunny in Northern Luzon. (Ang panahon is optional.)

examples.text: Dumulas pa naman ang daan.
examples.translation: Unfortunately, the road became slippery.

examples.text: Asahang aaliwalas ang panahon sa Katimugang Luzon.
examples.translation: Expect the weather in Southern Luzon to be better.

explanations.title: Exceptions
explanations.body: Not all ma adjectives convert into um verbs of weather. Makulay (colorful) does not turn into kumulay; it is a mag verb used with the particular color: Nagkulay berde ang tubig dahil sa baktirya (The water turned green because of the bacteria). “To become colorful” is maging makulay. Maulap turns into mag-ulap (to form clouds). Banayad and katamtaman are other weather-related adjectives that do not convert to um verbs. “To snow” is mag-snow or mag-isno.

explanations.title: Gerunds as a source of um verbs
explanations.body: Convert the gerunds into um verbs: Ang panahon ay magiging maulan na may pagkulog at pagkidlat. May pulu-pulong pag-ulan sa ilang bahagi ng Catanduanes na naging sanhi ng pag-ulan sa rehiyon ng Hilagang Luzon. Katamtamang pag-alon ng karagatan. Pagbaha ang naranasan ko. An example of how to change a sentence: dahil umulan sa rehiyon ng Hilagang Luzon (sanhi means “cause” and dahil is the conjunction of cause or reason). Basically, a phrase becomes a clause.

explanations.title: A word about ang + verb
explanations.body: The structure ang + verb is often translated “the one(s) who, that, which + verb.” It follows a sino, ano, alin or ilan question. When you see the marker ang followed by a verb, think of it as elliptical for “the one(s) who/that/which” plus the verb.

explanations.title: Activity 6: a weather report (the book’s script and key)
explanations.body: Key: 1. moderate to strong winds; 2. moderate to calm (rough in the book’s script: moderate to rough); 3. light to moderate winds; 4. calm to moderate; 5. sunrise 5:45 in the morning, sunset 5:54 p.m. (The report is from a Philstar weather column.)

examples.text: Katamtaman hanggang sa malakas na hangin mula sa timog-kanluran hanggang kanluran ang iiral sa Gitna at Katimugang Luzon.
examples.translation: Moderate to strong winds from the southwest to west will prevail over Central and Southern Luzon.

examples.text: Mula naman sa hilagang-silangan hanggang hilagang-kanluran sa natitirang bahagi ng Luzon, ang baybaying dagat sa mga lugar na ito ay magiging katamtaman hanggang sa maalon.
examples.translation: From the northeast to northwest in the rest of Luzon, the coastal waters of these areas will be moderate to rough.

examples.text: Sa ibang dako, ang hangin ay magiging mahina hanggang sa katamtaman mula sa timog-kanluran na may banayad hanggang sa katamtamang pag-alon ng karagatan.
examples.translation: Elsewhere, the winds will be light to moderate from the southwest with slight to moderate seas.

examples.text: Ang araw ay sisikat alas-singko kuwarenta y singko ng umaga at lulubog alas-singko singkuwenta y kuwatro ng gabi.
examples.translation: The sun will rise at a quarter to six in the morning and set at six minutes to six in the evening (the book’s key says sunrise 5:45 a.m. and sunset 5:54 p.m.).

explanations.title: Activity 7: match three short conversations with weather conditions (the book’s key)
explanations.body: A is a hot, muggy day; B is clear weather; C is stormy weather. Conversation A:

examples.text: Bagong ligo lang ako, e, basa na ako sa pawis.
examples.translation: A: I just took a bath, and I am already wet with sweat.

examples.text: Kaya nga ako, nag-shorts at kamiseta lang.
examples.translation: B: That is why I wore only shorts and a T-shirt.

examples.text: Bilisan nating maglakad at magpalamig sa mall. Gusto ko nang uminom ng malamig na malamig na tubig.
examples.translation: A: Let’s walk faster and cool off at the mall. I want to drink very cold water.

examples.text: Tamang-tama, sa Pagdiriwang ng Araw ng Kalayaan, mamasyal tayo sa Tagaytay. Sumakay tayo ng bangka sa Lake Taal at pagkatapos akyatin natin ang bulkan.
examples.translation: Father: How perfect, on the celebration of Independence Day, let’s go to Tagaytay. Let’s ride a boat on Lake Taal and then climb the volcano.

examples.text: Dalhin din natin ang mga bata sa Paradizoo sa hapon. Matutuwa ang mga iyon sumakay sa maliliit na kabayo.
examples.translation: Mother: Let’s also bring the children to Paradizoo in the afternoon. They will be delighted to ride the small horses.

examples.text: Saan ang lakad mo, anak?
examples.translation: Mother: Where are you going, son?

examples.text: Sa trabaho po. Dapat kasing tapusin ang experiment namin, e.
examples.translation: Son: To work. We have to finish our experiment, you see.

examples.text: Ngayon ka pa aalis, e, bumabagyo na. Magsuot ka ng kapote at botas. Mag-ingat ka. Delikado at madulas ang daan. O, heto ang payong.
examples.translation: Mother: You are leaving now, when it is already storming. Wear a raincoat and boots. Be careful. The road is dangerous and slippery. Here, take the umbrella.

explanations.title: Activity 7: the three weather statements and the matches
explanations.body: The book’s three weather conditions and its matches: statement 1 (clear weather) is B; statement 2 (overcast, nonstop rain) is C; statement 3 (extreme heat in Metro Davao) is A.

examples.text: Magiging maaliwalas ang panahon sa malawakang bahagi ng Pilipinas ngayong araw. Walang aasahang mga pag-ulan dahil sa walang kaulapan na makikita sa Timog Luzon, Visayas at Mindanao.
examples.translation: The weather will be clear over a wide part of the Philippines today. No rains are expected because no cloud cover is seen in Southern Luzon, the Visayas and Mindanao.

examples.text: Mananatiling makulimlim at makakaranas ng walang tigil na pag-ulan ang mga taga-Visayas at Mindanao na may kasamang pagkulog-pagkidlat.
examples.translation: Visayas and Mindanao residents will continue to see overcast skies and nonstop rain with thunder and lightning.

examples.text: Matinding init ng panahon ang mararanasan sa Metro Davao. Maaraw na may bahagyang ulap ang kalangitan. Iiral ang ganitong panahon buong araw at tinatayang magiging pinakamaalinsangan sa Metro Davao.
examples.translation: Extreme heat will be experienced in Metro Davao. The sky is sunny with slight clouds. This weather will prevail all day and Metro Davao is estimated to be the most muggy.

explanations.title: Activity 8: a weather report in two segments (the book’s script and key)
explanations.body: Key: Batanes and the Calayan Group of Islands will experience cloudy skies with light rains; Mindanao will have cloudy skies with light to moderate rain showers and thunderstorms; the rest of the country will be partly cloudy with isolated rain showers or thunderstorms, particularly over the Bicol Region and Eastern Visayas; Luzon, Eastern Visayas and Eastern Mindanao will have moderate to strong winds; the coastal waters will be moderate to rough; elsewhere, winds will be light to moderate from the northeast with slight to moderate seas.

examples.text: Ang mga isla ng Batanes at Calayan ay makakaranas ng maulap na kalangitan na may mahinang pag-ulan.
examples.translation: The islands of Batanes and Calayan will experience cloudy skies with light rain.

examples.text: Ang Mindanao ay magkakaroon ng maulap na papawirin na may mahina hanggang katamtamang pag-ulan at pagkidlat-pagkulog.
examples.translation: Mindanao will have cloudy skies with light to moderate rain and thunderstorms.

examples.text: Ang natitirang bahagi ng bansa ay magiging bahagyang maulap na may pulu-pulong pag-ulan o pagkidlat-pagkulog lalo na sa Kabikulan at Silangang Kabisayaan.
examples.translation: The rest of the country will be partly cloudy with isolated rain showers or thunderstorms, especially in Bicol and Eastern Visayas.

examples.text: Katamtaman hanggang sa malakas na hangin mula sa hilagang-silangan ang iiral sa Luzon, Silangang Kabisayaan at Silangang Mindanao at ang mga baybaying-dagat sa mga lugar na ito ay magiging katamtaman hanggang sa maalon.
examples.translation: Moderate to strong winds from the northeast will prevail in Luzon, Eastern Visayas and Eastern Mindanao and the coastal waters of these areas will be moderate to rough.

examples.text: Sa ibang dako, ang hangin ay mahina hanggang sa katamtaman mula sa hilagang-silangan na may banayad hanggang sa katamtaman ang pag-alon ng karagatan.
examples.translation: Elsewhere, winds will be light to moderate from the northeast with slight to moderate seas.

explanations.title: Activity 9: another report (the book’s script and key)
explanations.body: Key: 1. the skies in Metro Manila will be clear, although there might be rain sometime in the afternoon or evening; 2. a low-pressure area is developing that is affecting Mindanao; 3. sunrise was at 5:54 and sunset is expected at 5:25 in the afternoon (as printed); 4. Metro Manila, Tuguegarao City, Metro Davao and Zamboanga City will have the hottest temperature.

examples.text: Nakakaapekto pa rin sa Mindanao ang namumuong sama ng panahon.
examples.translation: The developing low-pressure area is still affecting Mindanao.

examples.text: Samantala, ang Metro Manila at iba pang bahagi ng bansa ay makakaranas ng maaliwalas na panahon ngayong araw na ito bagamat may mga pagbuhos ng ulan sa dakong hapon o gabi.
examples.translation: Meanwhile, Metro Manila and other parts of the country will experience clear weather today although there will be downpours in the afternoon or evening.

examples.text: Pinakamalamig pa rin sa Baguio City sa kinse degrees Celsius at pinakamaalinsangan naman ang panahon sa Metro Manila, Tuguegarao City, Metro Davao at Zamboanga City sa trenta y tres degrees Celsius.
examples.translation: It is still coldest in Baguio City at fifteen degrees Celsius and the weather is muggiest in Metro Manila, Tuguegarao City, Metro Davao and Zamboanga City at thirty-three degrees Celsius.

examples.text: Ang araw ay sumikat kaninang alas-singko singkuwenta y kuwatro ng umaga at inaasahang lulubog mamayang alas-singko beynte singko ng hapon.
examples.translation: The sun rose earlier at 5:54 in the morning and is expected to set later at 5:25 in the afternoon (as the book prints it).

lessons.subtitle: Hindi ako makakadalo dahil sa baha · Magandang oras ba para bumiyahe? · Glossary

explanations.title: Activity 10: guided conversation
explanations.body: You are Zenaida of Malabon City, a flood-prone area, invited by Daisy to a baptism ceremony and a dinner party in Makati City. A: apologize that you can’t attend because your barangay is flooded due to heavy rain; B: say no problem, you understand; A: say you called your mom, who lives close to Daisy’s house, and she promised to attend the baptism for you; B: thank her; A: say you have a gift for Daisy’s daughter and will give it next week; B: say no worries, thank her for calling. A sample:

examples.text: Daisy, pasensiya na, hindi ako makakadalo sa binyag at sa hapunan dahil baha sa barangay namin dahil sa malakas na ulan.
examples.translation: Zenaida: Daisy, I’m sorry, I can’t attend the baptism and the dinner because our barangay is flooded due to the heavy rain.

examples.text: Walang problema, naiintindihan ko ang sitwasyon.
examples.translation: Daisy: No problem, I understand the situation.

examples.text: Tinawagan ko ang nanay ko na malapit sa bahay mo at nangako siyang dadalo sa binyag para sa akin.
examples.translation: Zenaida: I called my mother, who lives near your house, and she promised to attend the baptism for me.

examples.text: Salamat.
examples.translation: Daisy: Thank you.

examples.text: May regalo ako para sa anak mong babae at ibibigay ko sa susunod na linggo.
examples.translation: Zenaida: I have a gift for your daughter and I will give it next week.

examples.text: Walang anuman. Salamat sa tawag.
examples.translation: Daisy: You’re welcome. Thank you for calling.

explanations.title: Activity 11: role play with a host family
explanations.body: You are a foreign language student staying with a Filipino host family; ask about the typical weather and use honorifics. Student A: it is 7:00 a.m., greet the host family; say you could hardly sleep because it was raining hard and the thunder and lightning were so loud, and that you are scared of them; say you and your classmates plan to go swimming at a beach in Subic the next day, Saturday, and ask if it is a good time to travel; say you will call your classmates to cancel. Student B: return the greetings; say June is the start of the rainy season and even typhoons and that thunder and lightning are pretty normal; say Subic is just four hours away, but if it is raining heavily the roads may be flooded in Manila and the north expressway may be too slippery; say to cancel the trip instead and wait for further weather updates. A sample:

examples.text: Magandang umaga po. Halos hindi po ako nakatulog kagabi dahil malakas ang ulan at napakalakas ng kulog at kidlat. Takot po ako sa kulog at kidlat.
examples.translation: Estudyante: Good morning. I could hardly sleep last night because the rain was heavy and the thunder and lightning were very loud. I am scared of thunder and lightning.

examples.text: Magandang umaga rin. Ang Hunyo ang simula ng tag-ulan at mga bagyo. Normal lang ang kulog at kidlat dito sa Pilipinas.
examples.translation: Host family: Good morning too. June is the start of the rainy season and typhoons. Thunder and lightning are quite normal here in the Philippines.

examples.text: Balak po naming magkaklase mag-swimming sa Subic bukas ng Sabado. Magandang oras po ba ito para bumiyahe?
examples.translation: Estudyante: My classmates and I plan to go swimming in Subic tomorrow, Saturday. Is it a good time to travel?

examples.text: Apat na oras lang ang Subic mula rito. Pero kapag malakas ang ulan, baka bumaha ang mga kalsada sa Maynila at madulas sa North Expressway. Ikansela na lang ninyo ang biyahe at hintayin ang susunod na ulat ng panahon.
examples.translation: Host family: Subic is just four hours from here. But if it rains heavily, the roads in Manila might flood and the North Expressway might be slippery. Just cancel the trip and wait for the next weather update.

examples.text: Sige po. Tatawagan ko ang mga kaklase ko para ikansela ang biyahe.
examples.translation: Estudyante: Okay. I will call my classmates to cancel the trip.

explanations.title: Activity 12: challenge yourself — radio commentators
explanations.body: Read the forecast, then (a) Partner A gathers the weather predicted for the day in three different regions and Partner B determines suitable activities; (b) consolidate and create, in Tagalog, a weather forecast script for the day with advice about activities suited to each region; (c) rehearse about 10 minutes and carry out your job as radio commentators. The book’s forecast (adapted from PAGASA) with its Tagalog translation:

examples.text: Ang Silangang Kabisayaan at rehiyon ng CARAGA ay makakaranas ng maulap na kalangitan na may mahina hanggang sa katamtaman na pag-ulan o pagkidlat-pagkulog.
examples.translation: Eastern Visayas and the CARAGA Region will experience cloudy skies with light to moderate rain or thunderstorms.

examples.text: Ang Cagayan Valley at ang mga lalawigan ng Aurora at Quezon ay magiging maulap na may mahinang pag-ulan.
examples.translation: Cagayan Valley and the provinces of Aurora and Quezon will be cloudy with light rain.

examples.text: Ang Metro Manila at ang nalalabing bahagi ng bansa ay magkakaroon ng bahagyang maulap na papawirin.
examples.translation: Metro Manila and the remaining parts of the country will have slightly cloudy skies.

examples.text: Katamtaman hanggang sa malakas na hangin mula sa silangan hanggang sa timog-silangan ang iiral sa Hilagang Luzon at mula naman sa hilagang-silangan sa natitirang bahagi ng bansa.
examples.translation: Moderate to strong winds from the east to southeast will prevail over Northern Luzon and from the northeast over the rest of the country.

examples.text: Ang mga baybaying-dagat sa buong kapuluan ay magiging katamtaman hanggang sa maalon.
examples.translation: The coastal waters throughout the archipelago will be moderate to rough.

rows: movement of waves in the open seas or ocean

explanations.title: Um verbs related to weather conditions: sample sentences
explanations.body: The book’s sample sentences (the verbs: bumabaha, kumidlat, kumulog, umambon, umiinit, umulan, humina, umiral, dumulas, umaraw, bumagyo, humangin, tumila, pumatak):

examples.text: Bumabaha sa mabababang lugar sa lungsod tuwing tag-ulan.
examples.translation: It floods in the low-lying areas of the city every rainy season.

examples.text: Noong makalawa, kumidlat at kumulog nang maraming beses sa loob ng kalahating oras, dahil sa matinding bagyo.
examples.translation: The day before yesterday, it flashed lightning and thundered many times within half an hour because of the severe storm.

examples.text: Nagtago sa ilalim ng hagdan ang aso noong biglang kumulog.
examples.translation: The dog hid under the stairs when it suddenly thundered.

examples.text: Kahit umambon lang, magpayong ka. Mahirap ang magkasakit.
examples.translation: Even if it only drizzles, use an umbrella. Getting sick is hard.

examples.text: Malapit na siguro ang tag-araw. Umiinit na nitong mga nakaraang ilang araw.
examples.translation: Summer must be near. It has been getting hotter these past few days.

examples.text: Makulimlim at umulan kanina. Ngayon naman, maaraw.
examples.translation: It was overcast and it rained earlier. Now it is sunny.

examples.text: Karaniwan, kapag humina ang bagyo sa isang lugar, dumadaan daw ang mata ng bagyo.
examples.translation: Usually, when the storm weakens in one place, they say the eye of the storm is passing.

examples.text: Malakas na hangin at manaka-nakang pag-ulan ang umiral buong araw.
examples.translation: Strong winds and occasional rain prevailed all day.

examples.text: Kapag dumulas ang kalsada, dulot ng ulan, mag-ingat sa pagmamaneho.
examples.translation: When the road becomes slippery because of the rain, be careful when driving.

examples.text: Kapag umaraw, lumabas tayo at mamili sa Nepa Q-Mart.
examples.translation: When it becomes sunny, let’s go out and shop at Nepa Q-Mart.

examples.text: Bumagyo nang ilang araw sa probinsiya, kaya ngayon lang ako nakabalik.
examples.translation: It stormed for several days in the province, so I only got back now.

examples.text: Sana naman humangin nang konti. Sobrang init ng panahon, e.
examples.translation: I hope the wind blows a little. The weather is so hot.

examples.text: Sana naman tumila na ang ulan. Kung hindi, babaha dito.
examples.translation: I hope the rain stops. If not, it will flood here.

explanations.title: Common words and phrases used in weather forecasts

examples.text: Ang nalalabing bahagi ng bansa ay magiging bahagyang maulap hanggang sa maulap na may pulu-pulong pag-ulan o pagkidlat-pagkulog.
examples.translation: The remaining parts of the country will be slightly cloudy to cloudy with isolated rain showers or thunderstorms.

examples.text: Maaaring makaranas ang ibang parte ng bansa ng maulap na panahon at pag-ulan na may kasamang kulog at kidlat mula Miyerkules.
examples.translation: Other parts of the country may experience cloudy weather and rain with thunder and lightning starting Wednesday.

examples.text: Magiging katamtaman hanggang sa maalon ang mga baybaying dagat sa mga lugar na ito.
examples.translation: The coastal waters in these areas will be moderate to rough.

examples.text: Sumemplang ang ilang motorcycle riders dahil sa basa at madulas na kalsada.
examples.translation: Some motorcycle riders skidded because of the wet and slippery road.

examples.text: Sa pagtaya ng panahon, maaasahan nga ba ang PAGASA?
examples.translation: In weather forecasting, can PAGASA really be relied on?

examples.text: Makakaranas pa rin ang buong bansa ng mainit at maaliwalas na panahon ngayong umaga, at mga pulo-pulong pag-ulan sa dakong hapon o gabi.
examples.translation: The whole country will still experience hot and clear weather this morning, and isolated rain showers in the afternoon or evening.

examples.text: Sa ibang dako, magiging mahina ang hangin mula sa hilagang-silangan.
examples.translation: Elsewhere, the wind from the northeast will be light.

explanations.title: Objectives
explanations.body: By the end of the lesson you can recognize more vocabulary commonly used in relation to severe weather conditions, answer comprehension questions about severe weather-related passages in reading and listening, transcribe and translate sentences using terms for severe weather conditions and talk about severe weather conditions using the expressions learned. The structures are the core vocabulary and a review of intensified and moderative adjectives and of pluralizing adjectives.

explanations.body: Hagupit literally means “whipping” or “beating”; the term commonly appears in weather reports. Hindi pala basta-basta bagyo lang means “not just an ordinary typhoon.” Kuryente (electricity), komunikasyon, naparalisa, transportasyon, lugar, plantasyon and perwisyo are Spanish cognates.

lessons.title: 158. C9 L3 · A blog about a typhoon, motorists and the Red Cross
lessons.subtitle: Bagyo na naman sa Maynila · Saksakan nang tigas ng ulo · Siyanga pala

explanations.title: Presentation 2: exchanges in a blog
explanations.body: Three bloggers comment on the effects of severe weather.

examples.text: Bagyo na naman sa Maynila. Nagkabuhul-buhol na naman ang trapiko. Pang-apat na araw na ngayon pero ubod nang lakas pa rin ng hangin na may pabugsu-bugsong pag-ulan.
examples.translation: Pinoy Batman: Another typhoon in Manila. The traffic is a tangle again. It is the fourth day now but the wind is still very strong with intermittent rain.

examples.text: Ang tindi tindi naman ng kalamidad! Tiyak, napakarami na namang sakuna sa daan. May mga motoristang saksakan nang tigas ng ulo din kasi. Hindi nakikinig sa mga babala at abiso ng PAGASA. Mabuti na lang mabilis rumesponde ang Red Cross volunteers. Kahit nga sa liblib na lugar nandoon sila para sumaklolo.
examples.translation: Pinay Kamaganda: The calamity is so intense! Surely there will be so many accidents on the road again. There are motorists who are very hardheaded too. They don’t listen to the warnings and advisories of PAGASA. Thankfully the Red Cross volunteers respond quickly. Even in far-flung places they are there to help.

examples.text: Siyanga pala, sabi ng PAGASA, medyo humihina na raw ang hanging amihan dala ng mainit na hangin. Hudyat na daw ito ng tag-init.
examples.translation: Poging Bisdak: By the way, PAGASA says the northeast monsoon is getting a bit weaker because of the easterly wind. It is a signal of summer, they say.

explanations.title: Notes and expressions
explanations.body: The cognate for sakuna is aksidente; both are commonly used. Learn the intensifiers ubod and saksakan; both mean “very”: ubod nang lakas (very strong), saksakan nang bagal (very slow), ubod nang hina (very weak), saksakan nang hina. Learn the expression siyanga pala (by the way), used when changing the topic of a conversation.

lessons.title: 159. C9 L3 · Intensified and moderative adjectives; pluralizing adjectives
lessons.subtitle: Ang lakas-lakas · Ubod nang lakas · Medyo mahina · Malalakas na bagyo

explanations.title: A. Intensified adjectives
explanations.body: Read these sentences from the presentations. The first three show one way of intensifying adjectives, using the duplicated word; the fourth shows a second way, using the prefix napaka. A third way is to add phrases like ubod nang, sobrang and saksakan ng to the root word.

examples.text: Ang lakas-lakas ng hagupit ng daluyong bagyo dito sa Samar.
examples.translation: The storm surge here in Samar is extremely strong.

examples.text: Ang lawak-lawak ng pinsala dito sa bayan.
examples.translation: The damage is very extensive here in the town.

examples.text: Wasak na wasak ang bukid.
examples.translation: The field was (very) damaged extensively.

examples.text: Tiyak, napakarami na namang sakuna sa daan.
examples.translation: Surely there will be a lot of accidents again on the streets.

examples.text: Ubod nang lakas pa rin ang hangin.
examples.translation: The wind is still very strong.

examples.text: Saksakan ng tigas ng ulo din kasi.
examples.translation: Because (someone) is also very hardheaded.

explanations.title: More ways to intensify
explanations.body: Other phrases to signify intensified adjectives are hari ng … and grabeng …, both translated “extremely.” A fourth way is to affix pagka to the duplicated root word: pagkalakas-lakas, pagkaganda-ganda, pagkatigas-tigas. There is no difference in meaning; this is a higher-level way of expressing intensified adjectives in Tagalog.

explanations.title: B. Moderative adjectives (taken up in Chapter 4)
explanations.body: Moderative adjectives translate as “a little ...”:

examples.text: Medyo humihina na raw ang hanging amihan.
examples.translation: They say the monsoon winds are getting a bit weaker.

examples.text: Marami-rami rin ang naapektuhan nang manalasa ang buhawi.
examples.translation: When the tornado hit, quite a number of people were affected.

examples.text: Malawak rin naman ang plantasyon.
examples.translation: The plantation is a little wide.

examples.text: Medyo mahina na nga.
examples.translation: It is indeed a little weak already.

examples.text: Medyo lubog nang kaunti sa tubig.
examples.translation: A little submerged in water.

examples.text: Medyo lubog sa tubig.
examples.translation: A little flooded.

explanations.title: Forms of moderative adjectives
explanations.body: Adding rin naman gives the moderative form: maganda rin naman means “a little pretty,” malamig rin naman “a little cold.” The moderative with rin naman comes with the entire adjective, not just the root word. Adding medyo to the entire adjective also creates a moderative: medyo mahina is “a little weak” (mahina is a ma adjective); medyo lubog sa tubig is “a little flooded” (lubog is a non-ma adjective). A third way is nang kaunti after the adjective: medyo lubog sa tubig becomes lubog nang kaunti sa tubig. Native speakers may put both medyo and nang kaunti in the same phrase: Medyo lubog nang kaunti sa tubig ang Maynila. Warning: nang kaunti cannot be placed immediately before a noun (Hindi ba marumi nang kaunting tubig-baha iyan? is wrong; use Hindi ba medyo maruming tubig-baha iyan? or marumi-ruming). Native speakers also tend to put kahit papano (paano) at the end of the moderative adjective; it loosely translates as “considering” and softens the effect of something negative.

explanations.title: C. Pluralizing adjectives
explanations.body: In Tagalog the adjective does not have to be in the plural form even if the noun is plural. There are five ways to signal plurality in an adjective + noun structure, subsumed under two general ways: the marker mga, and pluralizing the adjective itself. 1. Use mga before the singular adjective (mga malakas na bagyo), or with the noun and keep the adjective singular (malakas na mga bagyo). 2. Pluralize the adjective itself (malalakas na bagyo); then the noun does not need mga, and in translation the noun becomes plural. Caveat: native speakers are heard saying mga malalakas na mga bagyo, which embodies all the versions above.

explanations.title: Activity 2: rewrite with the specified adjective form (the book’s key, in part)
explanations.body: The book’s key: 1. Mainam na magbitbit ng maliit-liit na (or medyo maliit na) radyo. 2. Maagap (intensified): all intensified forms are possible. 3. Wasak (plural): NA, there is no plural form. 4. Pribadong (plural): all forms. 5. Matindi (intensified): all forms. 6. Makapal (moderative): all forms. 7. Malamig (intensified): all forms.

explanations.title: Activity 6: translate the words in boldface (the book’s key)
explanations.body: The weather report from PAGASA, with the book’s key for the five boldface phrases:

rows: Katamtaman hanggang sa malakas na hangin
Gitna at Katimugang Luzon at Kabisayaan
Central and Southern Luzon and the Visayas Region
will be moderate to rough coastal waters
may banayad hanggang katamtamang pag-alon ng karagatan
with light to moderate waves in the seas

examples.text: Ang buong bansa ay magiging bahagyang maulap na may pulu-pulong pag-ulan o pagkidlat-pagkulog.
examples.translation: The whole country will be partly cloudy with isolated rain showers or thunderstorms.

examples.text: Katamtaman hanggang sa malakas na hangin mula sa silangan hanggang timog-silangan ang iiral sa hilaga at silangang bahagi ng Hilagang Luzon at mula naman sa silangan sa silangang bahagi ng Gitna at Katimugang Luzon at ng Kabisayaan at ang mga baybaying-dagat sa mga lugar na ito ay magiging katamtaman hanggang sa maalon.
examples.translation: Moderate to strong winds from the east to southeast will prevail over the north and east of Northern Luzon, and from the east over the eastern part of Central and Southern Luzon and the Visayas, and the coastal waters of these areas will be moderate to rough.

examples.text: Mahina hanggang sa katamtaman mula sa timog-silangan ang iiral sa nalabing bahagi ng Hilagang Luzon at mula sa silangan hanggang hilagang-silangan sa nalalabing bahagi ng bansa na may banayad hanggang katamtamang pag-alon ng karagatan.
examples.translation: Light to moderate winds from the southeast will prevail over the remaining part of Northern Luzon, and from the east to northeast over the remaining part of the country, with slight to moderate seas.

explanations.title: Activity 7: figures from a news report about a ship disaster (the book’s script)
explanations.body: The book asks you to write the figures you hear. The report is adapted from an encyclopedia entry on the 2008 sinking of a passenger ship during a typhoon. Key:

rows: Date and time of departure from Manila to Cebu
Date and time the ship sank

examples.text: Noong alas-otso ng gabi, ika-beynte ng Hunyo, dalawang libo walo, lumayag mula sa Maynila patungong Cebu ang MV Princess of the Stars.
examples.translation: At eight in the evening on June 20, 2008, the MV Princess of the Stars sailed from Manila to Cebu.

examples.text: Ginawa ang barkong ito noong mil nobesiyentos otsenta y kuwatro.
examples.translation: This ship was built in 1984.

examples.text: Puwede itong magkarga ng isang libo siyamnaraa’t siyamnapu’t siyam katao.
examples.translation: It could carry one thousand nine hundred ninety-nine people.

examples.text: Sa kasagsagan ng bagyong Frank, lumayag ang barko at direktang tinamaan ng bagyo.
examples.translation: At the height of typhoon Frank, the ship sailed and was directly hit by the typhoon.

examples.text: Nasiraan ng makina ang MV Princess of the Stars at sinalubong ng malakas na bagyo.
examples.translation: The MV Princess of the Stars had engine trouble and was met by the strong typhoon.

examples.text: Lumubog ito Sabado ng tanghali, ika-beynte uno ng Hunyo.
examples.translation: It sank on Saturday noon, June 21.

examples.text: Ayon sa huling ulat, umabot sa isandaa’t labimpito ang mga namatay, isandaa’t tatlumpu’t siyam ang malubhang nasugatan, at apatnapu’t apat ang nawawala.
examples.translation: According to the latest report, the dead reached one hundred seventeen, one hundred thirty-nine were seriously injured and forty-four were missing.

examples.text: Mga dalawampu’t walo ang nabuhay matapos makayanang makalangoy papuntang Mulanay, Quezon.
examples.translation: About twenty-eight survived after managing to swim to Mulanay, Quezon.

lessons.title: 162. C9 L3 · Listening: a Red Cross call and news about floods, drought and Typhoon Agaton
lessons.subtitle: Kailangan po namin ng dagdag na volunteers · Walang tigil na pag-ulan · Nadagdagan ang bilang ng nasawi

explanations.title: Activity 8, passage 1: a Red Cross volunteer and her team leader (the book’s script and key)
explanations.body: Key: storm surge; the volunteer requested additional volunteers, canned goods, clean water and plenty of medicines; effects: impassable road, no power, no communication, no transportation.

examples.text: Hello, hello po Ms. Abad, kailangan po namin ng dagdag na mga volunteers dito, mga de-latang pagkain, malinis na tubig, at marami pong gamot. Ang lawak po ng pinsala na dulot ng daluyong ng bagyo.
examples.translation: A: Hello, hello Ms. Abad, we need additional volunteers here, canned goods, clean water and plenty of medicine. The damage caused by the storm surge is so extensive.

examples.text: Sa lokasyon mo ngayon, may madadaanan ba?
examples.translation: B: Is there any passable route from your location now?

examples.text: Wala po, Ms. Abad. Naparalisa po lahat ng transportasyon, walang kuryente, at walang komunikasyon. Nasa kabilang bayan po ako kung saan may signal.
examples.translation: A: None, Ms. Abad. All transportation is paralyzed, there is no electricity and no communication. I am in the next town where there is a signal.

examples.text: Sige, walang problema. Magpapadala ako ng tulong sa lalong madaling panahon.
examples.translation: B: Okay, no problem. I will send help as soon as possible.

explanations.title: Activity 8, passage 2: a mother and her daughter (the book’s script and key)
explanations.body: Key: the mother was angry because she was worried about her daughter driving at night despite bad weather; her three instructions: next time do not travel if the weather is bad; listen to the weather warnings and announcements; change clothes because she might get sick.

examples.text: Saksakan naman ng tigas ng ulo mo. Bakit ka pa nagmaneho gabing-gabi na at madulas pa ang daan. Ang lakas-lakas ng hangin.
examples.translation: A: You are so hardheaded. Why did you still drive so late at night when the road is still slippery. The wind is so strong.

examples.text: E, kasi ’Nay, nung umalis po ako ng dormitoryo, pabugso-bugso pa lang yung ulan. Nung nasa EDSA na ako, aba’y biglang bumuhos ang ulan at ubod ng lakas ng hangin. ’Yun nagkabuhol-buhol na ang trapiko.
examples.translation: B: Well, Mom, when I left the dormitory the rain was only intermittent. When I was on EDSA, suddenly the rain poured and the wind was very strong. Then the traffic became a tangle.

examples.text: Sa susunod wag ka nang magbiyahe na masama ang panahon. Makinig ka sa mga abiso. Magbihis ka na nga at baka ka magkasakit.
examples.translation: A: Next time don’t travel when the weather is bad. Listen to the advisories. Go change clothes now or you might get sick.

examples.text: Opo ’Nay.
examples.translation: B: Yes, Mom.

explanations.title: Activity 9, passage 1: a news report on floods (the book’s script and key)
explanations.body: Key: continuous rain and flooding; Region 12 and some parts of Mindanao; the other concerns were landslide and flash flood.

examples.text: Sa tatlong araw na walang tigil na pag-ulan mahigit isang libong pamilya na ang apektado ng pagbaha sa Rehiyon Dose.
examples.translation: After three days of nonstop rain more than one thousand families are affected by flooding in Region 12.

examples.text: Ayon sa Office of Civil Defense Rehiyon Dose naramdaman ang epekto ng low pressure area at inter tropical convergence zone sa rehiyon at sa iba pang parte ng Mindanao.
examples.translation: According to the Office of Civil Defense Region 12, the effect of the low pressure area and the inter-tropical convergence zone was felt in the region and other parts of Mindanao.

examples.text: Kaugnay nito wala namang naiulat na nasawi sa naganap na pagbaha.
examples.translation: In connection with this, no deaths were reported in the flooding that occurred.

examples.text: Habang patuloy pa rin silang naka-alerto para sa posibleng pagguho ng lupa at biglaang pagbaha.
examples.translation: Meanwhile they remain on alert for a possible landslide and flash flood.

explanations.title: Activity 9, passage 2: a news report on drought (the book’s script and key)
explanations.body: Key: drought; more than 300 million pesos worth of damage; more than 200 million pesos worth of damage to corn; more than 500 domestic animals or livestock died; the farmers requested more aid from the government.

examples.text: Umabot na nga sa higit tatlundaang milyong piso ang naitalang pinsala ng patuloy na tag-init dala ng El Niño phenomenon sa lalawigan o sa bahaging iyan ng Cordillera.
examples.translation: The damage recorded from the continuing dry weather brought by the El Niño phenomenon in the province, in that part of the Cordillera, has reached more than three hundred million pesos.

examples.text: Higit dalawandaang milyong piso na ang pinsala sa maisan.
examples.translation: The damage to the cornfields is more than two hundred million pesos.

examples.text: Bukod dito, higit limang daang alagang hayop din ang namatay.
examples.translation: Besides this, more than five hundred domestic animals also died.

examples.text: Bagama’t isinailalim sa state of calamity ang lalawigan, hiling pa rin ng mga apektadong magsasaka na mabigyan sila ng dagdag na tulong mula sa pamahalaan.
examples.translation: Although the province was placed under a state of calamity, the affected farmers still ask to be given additional help from the government.

explanations.title: Activity 10: an excerpt of a news report (the book’s script and key)
explanations.body: Key: type of severe weather: typhoon and landslide; damage to infrastructure: 273 million pesos; casualties: 68; wounded: 85; missing: 9; families affected: 16,000.

examples.text: Nadagdagan pa ang bilang ng mga nasawi sa pananalasa ng bagyong Agaton sa ilang lugar sa Mindanao.
examples.translation: The number of the dead has increased with the onslaught of typhoon Agaton in some places in Mindanao.

examples.text: Sa pinakahuling tala ng NDRRMC, umakyat na sa animnapu’t walo ang nasawi habang walumpu’t lima ang sugatan at siyam pa rin ang pinaghahanap.
examples.translation: In the latest record of the NDRRMC, the dead have risen to sixty-eight while eighty-five are wounded and nine are still being searched for.

examples.text: Bumaba naman sa labing-anim na libong pamilya ang naapektuhan ng naturang sama ng panahon.
examples.translation: The families affected by the said bad weather went down to sixteen thousand.

examples.text: Samantala umaabot na sa mahigit dalawandaa’t pitumpu’t tatlong milyong piso ang halaga ng imprastrakturang sinira ng ilang araw na pag-ulan at pagguho ng lupa.
examples.translation: Meanwhile the value of the infrastructure destroyed by several days of rain and landslides has reached more than two hundred seventy-three million pesos.

explanations.title: Activity 11: guided conversation
explanations.body: You are MSGT Macalinta of the Philippine Army, part of the rescue team during a typhoon that hit Bacolod City. At 1600 hours, call your unit commander: say you need volunteers, food and medicines and that the tsunami was so severe that the entire town was badly damaged. B asks about the number of injured, the casualties and the approximate number of houses destroyed; A says about 30 slightly injured, 5 seriously injured, 5 deaths, about 50 houses totally destroyed and about 200 million pesos damage to plantations; B says he will send more troops and civilian volunteers. Use buhawi, naapektuhan, nasalanta, malubhang nasugatan, namatay, nasawi, pinsala, napinsala, kabuuang pinsala, bahagyang nasira, nawasak, lubos na nawasak and others. A sample:

examples.text: Magandang hapon po, Kumander. Kailangan po namin ng volunteers, pagkain at gamot. Napakalakas ng tsunami kaya lubhang napinsala ang buong bayan.
examples.translation: MSGT Macalinta: Good afternoon, Commander. We need volunteers, food and medicine. The tsunami was so strong that the whole town was severely damaged.

examples.text: Ilan ang nasugatan at namatay? Mga ilang bahay ang nawasak ng tsunami?
examples.translation: Kumander: How many were injured and killed? About how many houses were destroyed by the tsunami?

examples.text: May tatlumpung bahagyang nasugatan, limang malubhang nasugatan at limang namatay. Mga limampung bahay ang lubos na nawasak. May naiulat ding pinsalang dalawandaang milyong piso sa mga plantasyon.
examples.translation: MSGT Macalinta: There are about thirty slightly injured, five seriously injured and five dead. About fifty houses were totally destroyed. Damage of two hundred million pesos to the plantations was also reported.

examples.text: Magpapadala ako ng mas maraming sundalo at sibilyang volunteers sa lugar.
examples.translation: Kumander: I will send more troops and civilian volunteers to the area.

explanations.title: Activity 12: role play, a storm surge warning
explanations.body: You are Miranda; your friend Jojie lives in Leyte. At 5 p.m. greet him, say you heard there will be a storm surge, advise him to leave immediately and take shelter on high ground; if he has no place, offer your brother on a nearby island where he and his family can stay temporarily, a safe, unflooded place; give the brother’s full name, complete address and phone number. Jojie (B): returns the greeting, says you all heard it on TV news, that you, your wife and kids are packing important belongings, thanks Miranda and says you don’t have a place yet, asks for the brother’s name, address and number, and thanks Miranda. A sample (the brother’s details are left out):

examples.text: Magandang hapon, Jojie. Narinig kong may darating na daluyong ng bagyo.
examples.translation: Miranda: Good afternoon, Jojie. I heard there will be a storm surge.

examples.text: Magandang hapon din, Miranda. Narinig din namin sa balita sa TV.
examples.translation: Jojie: Good afternoon too, Miranda. We also heard it on the TV news.

examples.text: Umalis na kayo agad at humanap ng matutuluyan sa mataas na lugar. Kung wala kayong matutuluyan, may kapatid akong lalaki sa kalapit na isla na puwedeng tumanggap sa inyo ng pamilya mo. Ligtas ang lugar at tiyak na hindi binabaha.
examples.translation: Miranda: Leave immediately and find shelter on high ground. If you have no place to stay, I have a brother on a nearby island who can take you and your family in. The place is safe and certainly not flooded.

examples.text: Nag-iimpake na kami ng asawa ko at ng mga bata ng mahahalagang gamit. Salamat sa pag-aalala, Miranda. Wala pa kaming matutuluyan. Puwede ko bang malaman ang pangalan, address at numero ng kapatid mo?
examples.translation: Jojie: My wife, the kids and I are packing important belongings. Thank you for your concern, Miranda. We don’t have a place to stay yet. May I know your brother’s name, address and number?

examples.text: Oo, ibibigay ko ang kumpletong detalye. Mag-ingat kayo.
examples.translation: Miranda: Yes, I will give the complete details. Take care.

examples.text: Maraming salamat sa tulong.
examples.translation: Jojie: Thank you very much for the help.

explanations.title: Activity 13: challenge yourself, a situation report
explanations.body: The book prints an authentic English situation report of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council on the effects of typhoon Pablo (as of December 13, 2012, 10 a.m.). Two partners translate it into Tagalog, using Tagalog and Spanish derivatives for numbers, and report it in the order of the headings. Student 1 covers the affected population (barangays, municipalities, families and persons), casualties (dead and injured), lifelines (impassable bridges and roads, areas with power interruption), damaged properties (houses totally damaged), the cost of damage (total, and infrastructure) and the cost of assistance (total, the social welfare department and local governments). Student 2 covers the evacuation centers (families and persons served), casualties (missing and rescued), lifelines (water supply and communication interruptions), houses partially damaged, the cost of damage to agriculture and private property, and the cost of assistance from the health department, the council and other agencies. A summary of its figures (numbers of 1000 and above are written out in the book; here are the figures):

rows: Placed under a state of national calamity on December 7, 2012.
1,946 barangays, 252 municipalities and 36 cities in 30 provinces; 528,750 families and 5,474,313 persons; 63 evacuation centers serving 19,212 families and 79,885 persons.

19 bridges and 7 roads still not passable; 35 areas with power interruption; 6 areas with water supply interruption; communication restored in Compostela Valley and only 3 areas in Davao Oriental still interrupted.
About 14.3 billion pesos: 4.575 billion to infrastructure, 9.679 billion to agriculture, 48.7 million to private property.
About 76.4 million pesos from the Department of Social Welfare and Development, local government units, the Department of Health, the NDRRMC and other agencies.

explanations.title: Words and phrases used to report severe weather: sample sentences
explanations.body: The book’s sample sentences (the book misprints cliimate and senyal; they are corrected here):

examples.text: Ayon sa abiso ng DepEd, walang klase sa elementarya at hayskul dahil sa itinaas na ng PAGASA ang senyal bilang dalawa sa Metro Manila.
examples.translation: According to the DepEd advisory, there are no classes in elementary and high school because PAGASA has raised signal number two in Metro Manila.

examples.text: Ilang babala na ang narinig natin na masama ang El Niño ngayong taon.
examples.translation: We have heard several warnings that this year’s El Niño is bad.

examples.text: Samantala, nakaranas ng buhawi ang ilang bahagi ng Kamaynilaan. Pero ano nga ba ang buhawi?
examples.translation: Meanwhile, some parts of Greater Manila experienced a tornado. But what really is a tornado?

examples.text: Ang pag-apaw o pagragasa ng tubig-dagat sa lupa dulot ng bagyo ang tinatawag na daluyong ng bagyo.
examples.translation: The overflow or rushing of seawater onto land caused by a typhoon is called a storm surge.

examples.text: Libu-libong tao ang apektado ng panganib mula sa matinding lagay ng panahon tulad ng ipu-ipo at bagyo.
examples.translation: Thousands of people are affected by the danger from severe weather such as cyclones and typhoons.

examples.text: Nararanasan pa rin ang malawakang pagbaha, sa kabila ng maaraw na panahon sa Bataan.
examples.translation: Extensive flooding is still being experienced, despite the sunny weather in Bataan.

examples.text: Dahil sa climate change, ang wet season natin ay magiging mas malubha at ang tag-init ay magiging mas mainit.
examples.translation: Because of climate change our wet season will become more severe and the summer hotter.

examples.text: Labis na naaapektuhan ang mga pananim at livestocks sa pagtama ng tagtuyot.
examples.translation: Crops and livestock are greatly affected when a drought hits.

examples.text: Lampas na yata sa Signal Number Tres ang bagyong ito dahil ubod nang lakas ng hangin, e.
examples.translation: This typhoon has probably gone past Signal Number Three because the wind is very strong.

explanations.title: Words and phrases used to report the effects of severe weather: sample sentences

examples.text: Sa oras ng kalamidad, siguraduhin na nasa loob ng bahay ang mga bata.
examples.translation: In times of calamity, make sure the children are inside the house.

examples.text: Gumuho ang isang bahagi ng national highway sa Aleosan, Cotabato dahil sa matinding pag-ulan.
examples.translation: A part of the national highway in Aleosan, Cotabato caved in because of heavy rain.

examples.text: Naapektuhan ang libu-libong pamilya ng sunud-sunod na pagbagyo at pagbaha.
examples.translation: Thousands of families were affected by the successive storms and floods.

examples.text: Nagkabuhol-buhol ang trapik nang biglang bumuhos ang malakas na ulan na tumagal nang kulang-kulang dalawang oras.
examples.translation: The traffic became a tangle when the heavy rain suddenly poured and lasted a little less than two hours.

examples.text: Dalawang turista ang nalunod sa dagat dahil sa masamang panahon sa Casiguran, Aurora.
examples.translation: Two tourists drowned in the sea because of bad weather in Casiguran, Aurora.

examples.text: Nanalasa sa Isabela ang malakas na hangin at ulang dala ng bagyo.
examples.translation: The strong wind and rain brought by the typhoon struck Isabela.

examples.text: Mistulang naparalisa ang buong probinsiya ng Leyte dahil sa bagyong Yolanda.
examples.translation: The whole province of Leyte seemed paralyzed because of typhoon Yolanda.

examples.text: Mga linya ng komunikasyon, naputol dahil sa masamang panahon dulot ng bagyong Labuyo.
examples.translation: Communication lines were cut because of the bad weather brought by typhoon Labuyo.

examples.text: Umakyat na sa apatnapu’t walo ang bilang ng mga nasawi sa masamang panahon, ayon sa NDRRMC.
examples.translation: The number of dead in the bad weather has risen to forty-eight, according to the NDRRMC.

examples.text: Halos nasira ang lahat ng mga ari-arian ng pamilyang Crisologo dahil sa matinding bagyo.
examples.translation: Almost all the properties of the Crisologo family were destroyed because of the severe typhoon.

examples.text: Nasugatan ang limang katao nang tumama ang lumilipad na yero sa kanilang bahay.
examples.translation: Five people were injured when a flying sheet of galvanized iron hit their house.

examples.text: Nawawala pa rin ang sampung taong gulang na batang babae na nahiwalay sa kanyang pamilya habang lumilikas.
examples.translation: The ten-year-old girl who was separated from her family while evacuating is still missing.

examples.text: Malaking perwisyo ang idinulot ng buhawi sa mga mamamayan ng Kansas City.
examples.translation: The tornado caused great inconvenience to the residents of Kansas City.

examples.text: Aabot sa bilyon-bilyong piso ang halaga ng pinsala sa mga ari-arian at pananim noong nakaraang taon.
examples.translation: The damage to properties and crops last year will amount to billions of pesos.

examples.text: Tinangay ng alon ang isang babaeng nagpunta sa tabing-dagat kahit masama ang panahon.
examples.translation: A woman who went to the seashore despite the bad weather was carried away by the waves.

lessons.title: 164. C10 L1 · Two friends plan trips: a ship and roro route, and choosing an airline
lessons.subtitle: Gusto ko sanang pumunta ng Dakak · Alin ang mura? · Matipid ang magbarko

explanations.title: Objectives
explanations.body: By the end of the lesson you can recognize vocabulary commonly used in air, land and sea travel; answer comprehension questions to show understanding of short reading and listening passages concerning travel; transcribe and translate sentences about travel; speak about traveling by air, land and sea; and use the question word alin. The structures are the core vocabulary, the enclitics sana, muna, na, yata and kasi, and the question word alin.

explanations.title: Getting started
explanations.body: The book shows a mind map of different modes of transportation in the Philippines and asks you to add more in Tagalog (the mind map is left out).

explanations.title: Presentation 1A: two friends choose the best mode of transportation
explanations.body: Pictures show a ship, a roro vessel and a jeepney (left out).

examples.text: Gusto ko po sanang pumunta ng Dakak sa Dapitan. Ano po kaya ang pinakamurang paraan para makarating doon? Napakamahal kasing mag-eroplano.
examples.translation: Woman: I hope to go to Dakak in Dapitan. What might be the cheapest way to get there? It is too expensive to take a plane.

examples.text: Puwede kang magbarko mula dito sa Maynila papuntang Iloilo. Mula Iloilo, magroro ka hanggang Cebu. Tapos, magbarko ka ulit papuntang Dipolog.
examples.translation: Man: You can take a ship from here in Manila to Iloilo. From Iloilo, take a roro up to Cebu. Then take a ship again to Dipolog.

examples.text: Mga ilang oras ho ang biyahe?
examples.translation: Woman: About how many hours is the trip?

examples.text: Mga anim na oras yata. Pagdating mo sa Dipolog, sumakay ka ng habal-habal papuntang Dakak. Marami ring dyip doon pero hindi nagbibiyahe ng Dakak.
examples.translation: Man: It looks like about six hours. When you arrive in Dipolog, ride a habal-habal to Dakak. There are also many jeepneys there but they don’t travel to Dakak.

examples.text: Mahaba-haba din pala. Iisipin ko na po muna.
examples.translation: Woman: That is quite long, then. I will think about it first.

examples.text: Pero matipid at marami ka pang makikitang ibang lugar.
examples.translation: Man: But it is economical and you will see many other places.
